name: Yaegashi Chikae
source:
"The Spy Master"
Hobbies: Piano

A third-year and the Spy Club's creator. Chikae is the only child of her family but very wealthy. Her personality is like that of a rich girl's: selfish, arrogant and pushy. However, she possesses a lot of charisma which has helped her to become popular.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=689783]The Getchu site[/url]]
